panels.title: ANSIBLE-FORGE · stack builds

panels.description: Result of the last weekly Molecule run (play_weekly_molecule.sh, Thursday 0400, after the weekly builds) for the Grafana stack. Deployment role = the configure_grafana_stack role on a Debian container; nucleus images / ccop images = the actual weekly images started on the role-staged config. Green OK = tests ran and passed. Red FAILED = the latest weekly image or the role config broke (see /opt/ansible/molecule/logs/). Amber NOT REPORTED = not tested this week (no fresh image) or the scenario has not run yet. Deployed on std1: the production configure_grafana_stack role deployed this week's nucleus images on std1 (signature check, firewall, compose, wipe-and-redeploy) and the running stack passed its checks (grafana12-deploy).

targets.expr: pipeline_weekly_molecule_status{stack="grafana"} or on(test) label_replace(vector(-1), "test", "role-config", "", "") or on(test) label_replace(vector(-1), "test", "image-nucleus", "", "") or on(test) label_replace(vector(-1), "test", "image-ccop", "", "") or on(test) label_replace(vector(-1), "test", "deployment", "", "")

panels.description: One row per weekly Molecule test that failed or was not tested in its last run, written by play_weekly_molecule.sh to pipeline_weekly_molecule.prom. 'What failed' is the first failed Ansible task in that test's log (ignored errors are skipped) and 'Reason' is its error message; open the log on ansible-forge for the full output. Not-tested rows give the reason the test was skipped. Empty when every test passed.

panels.description: Components of the current quarterly release that failed to build, scan or sign and so ship their last good release instead: the previous quarter's signed images and scan results (status fallback), or that have no release at all (status failed - the stack build fails and no docker-compose.yml is rendered). Written by the quarterly build (stack_finish.yml) to pipeline_quarterly_<stack>.prom; the same list is in files/<stack>/<quarter>/fallback.env. Empty when every component was built this quarter. Grafana stack only until the Guacamole build is split per component.

'Ignored' = tasks whose errors the playbook deliberately ignores (for example signing): a build can be OK with some ignored errors.
